clientBuildEvidence: User confirmed same TestFlight build 5, connected for the 20 Mbps comparison; no receiver JSON yet.
network: Remote Surge Ponte, user reported; outer direct/relay path unobserved
clientFeedback: User reports stable 10+ fps and worse experience than 45 Mbps.

sampling.method: Deduplicate live snapshots by session seconds. First snapshot predates collector start. No reconnect/counter reset observed. Counter rates use first-to-last deltas; metric summaries use observed one-second samples. Missing samples are not filled.

notes: Host-only observation: host packetsLost/freezeCount/framesDecoded zeros do not establish receiver loss/freeze/decode results.
NACK is feedback count, not lost-packet count. Retransmissions can repeat the same media packet.
Control RTT is DataChannel ping/pong, not input-to-photon latency. Its sample P95 can hide isolated large stalls.
Send-delay and encode-delay P95 aggregate interval means, not per-packet or per-frame values.
Host application bridge queue age excludes WebRTC, kernel, Surge, and receiver queues.
wireMbps is the host bridge datagram-byte delta, not physical VPN/on-wire bandwidth.
20 Mbps is a configured ceiling. A one-second sample may exceed it during bursts/recovery; it is not a strict instantaneous cap.
No source or transport settings were changed during this observation. No concurrent builds or media benchmarks were run.
Comparison is sequential on a live remote connection, not repeated randomized trials; outer network conditions were not controlled.
Stats framesPerSecond is a rolling/quantized sample and its mean differs from counter-derived FPS. Use frame-count delta divided by elapsed sample time to compare throughput.
